Bid Summary.value: Bid number 2025-003 from Delano Union School District seeks to purchase 500 Dell Chrome 3120 Chromebooks, 500 Google Chrome OS Management Console Licenses, and 500 Dell Optical Mice (MS 116 or functionally equivalent). The bid is due on September 6, 2024, 1:00 PM, and the term of the contract will be twelve (12) months as a Purchase Contract. Bidders must provide a bid security of 10% bid security in cash, a certified cashier’s check or a bid bond, and must submit the required documentation, including the Instructions to Bidders, Bid Form, Substitution Listing, Workers' Compensation Certificate, Guarantee, and a signed form. Delivery of the goods is required by November30,2024 and the specification for the Chromebook is the HP Fortis 11 inch G10 model. Contact Sandra Rivera, Assistant Superintendent of Business, at srivera@duesd.org or (661) 721-5000 ext. 00125 for any questions, noting that some details such as pre-bid meeting and bid submission type are not specified.
